research_question: Does maintaining two ready copies improve HTTP outcomes during rollout under a load that stresses one copy?

selection.reason: Lowest async-pilot rate where one copy had errors and two had none; three independent repeats then confirmed one-copy error rates above 1% and two-copy rates at 0%.

validity_checks: all scheduled sequence IDs accounted for exactly once
p95 client scheduling delay no larger than one arrival interval
final 100 successful responses contain v2 only
interpretation: Service errors are an outcome; do not change load or application implementation to force a preferred A/B conclusion. Preserve exploratory and invalid runs separately. Report repeats and variation.
initial_threaded_series: pilot_01 is low-load exploration; pilot_02 was interrupted after scheduling/saturation problems. Do not pool these with async confirmation.
execution: Codex runs this additional series at the student's request; student ran the original 12 runs.
